name: Record 4
definition: Message in file message identified as a batch record.

SequenceCounter.name: Sequence Counter
SequenceCounter.definition: Sequence counter of the record from 1 to n

RecordChecksumInputValue.name: Record Checksum Input Value
RecordChecksumInputValue.definition: Value of the record to use for the computation of the checksum of the batch.

OriginatorIdentification.name: Originator Identification
OriginatorIdentification.definition: Identification of the originator of the transaction.

OriginatorAssigner.name: Originator Assigner
OriginatorAssigner.definition: Identification of the entity assigning the originator identification.

DestinationIdentification.name: Destination Identification
DestinationIdentification.definition: Identification of the destination of the transaction.

DestinationAssigner.name: Destination Assigner
DestinationAssigner.definition: Identification of the entity assigning the destination identification.

ClearingMethod.name: Clearing Method
ClearingMethod.definition: Type of clearing of the transaction. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

ClearingCurrency.name: Clearing Currency
ClearingCurrency.definition: Currency code of the net clearing amount.

InterchangeFeeCurrency.name: Interchange Fee Currency
InterchangeFeeCurrency.definition: Currency code of interchange fee amount.

InterchangeFeeCreditDebit.name: Interchange Fee Credit Debit
InterchangeFeeCreditDebit.definition: Sign of the interchange fee amount.

AgentFeeCurrency.name: Agent Fee Currency
AgentFeeCurrency.definition: Currency code Gross clearing accumulated amount.

RecordMessage.name: Record Message
RecordMessage.definition: Message to be sent in a batch transfer as a record.
